Our Finance team plays a critical role in supporting our rapid growth and ensuring operational excellence. We value technical expertise, collaborative problem-solving, and a commitment to accuracy and compliance. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our financial infrastructure while working at the intersection of finance and transformative technology. As we scale our business and navigate an evolving financial landscape, you'll play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and serving as a key partner on accounting implications of major business decisions. In this role, you will: - Lead the complete month-end close process, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting across all entities - Prepare and review the consolidated financial statements, including the statement of cash flows, and support various management reporting requirements - Own lease accounting, including accounting assessment under ASC 842, recording and reconciliation of lease-related account transactions, financial reporting, and disclosures - Own equity accounting such as stock-based compensation under ASC 718 and IFRS, as well as all other equity-related balance sheet accounts - Own deferred commission accounting under ASC 340-40, including capitalization, amortization, and reconciliation of contract acquisition costs, and related disclosures - Oversee foreign currency accounting, including functional currency assessment, transaction exposure, and translation adjustments - Assist with recording purchase accounting, including purchase price adjustments, acquisition-related expenses, fair value allocations, and related reconciliations - Direct general ledger operations, account reconciliations, and financial statement preparation - Implement and maintain robust accounting policies, procedures, systems, and internal controls - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure financial accuracy and support business growth - Leverage technology solutions to enhance accounting efficiency and accuracy You may be a good fit if you: - Have 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, with prior leadership in fast-paced environments - Possess strong technical accounting skills and deep understanding of GAAP principles, including lease accounting, equity accounting, business combination, and foreign currency - Have direct experience owning month-end close processes using close management tools such as Numeric - Demonstrate expertise in purchase accounting, including acquisitions, purchase price adjustments, and related reconciliations - Experience with leveraging AI tools to build and improve workflows to achieve operational efficiency and accuracy - Demonstrate excellence in problem-solving and process improvement methodologies - Show proficiency with financial systems (Netsuite preferred, but not required) - items.title: Customer Experience Specialist
items.description: About Polymarket Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. About the Role The CX team at Polymarket is small, and the work is real. When a major market resolves, when a news event sends volume spiking, or when a user can't access their funds, this team is the first line of response. You won't be reading from a script. You'll be making judgment calls, writing clearly under pressure, and working directly with policy and product to surface what's actually happening on the platform. This hire matters because Polymarket is growing fast and the complexity of user issues is growing with it. Prediction markets are not a familiar product for most people, and crypto adds another layer. Users come in with high expectations and, sometimes, real money on the line. The person in this role needs to handle that seriously, communicate with precision, and know when to escalate and when to resolve. You'll be working across chat, email, and social channels, often during high-stakes moments when markets are resolving and queues are full. The job requires genuine curiosity about how markets work, a tolerance for ambiguity, and the ability to write a clear, accurate response on the first try. What You'll Do - Resolve user support tickets across chat, email, and social channels, handling everything from account issues to questions about how specific markets work. - Investigate disputed market resolutions, gather the relevant context, and escalate edge cases to the policy team with a clear summary of the issue. - Track recurring user issues, identify patterns, and write up findings in a format the product team can actually use. - Draft and update help center articles based on questions that keep coming in, making complex topics accessible without dumbing them down. - Monitor CX queues during high-volume events, coordinate coverage with teammates, and flag when incoming volume or issue types require escalation. - Work cross-functionally with policy, product, and operations to close the loop on issues that fall outside standard support flows. What We're Looking For - 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing support role, ideally in a high-volume or fast-moving environment. - Strong written communication skills, specifically the ability to write clear, accurate, and empathetic responses quickly and without heavy editing. - Comfort operating in ambiguous situations where the right answer isn't always documented and you have to use judgment. - Ability to learn unfamiliar technical concepts quickly, including how prediction markets resolve and how crypto transactions work. - (Plus) Prior experience at a crypto or fintech company, with working knowledge of wallets, transactions, or trading products. - (Plus) Hands-on experience with Zendesk, Intercom, or a comparable support platform. - (Plus) Genuine interest in markets, current events, or forecasting, the kind that means you already understand why someone would care about a prediction market. Benefits - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Life Sciences - SF
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with global pharma and biotech, CROs, and research institutions to deploy existing expertise across the R&D value chain to help customers design and ship production-grade AI systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development, converting early deployments into repeatable system standards and evaluation practices that scale across regulated environments. About the role We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to push the frontier on what is possible today across drug discovery (e.g., target identification, molecular design, pre-clinical) and development (e.g., trial design, trial ops, biostats) by leading end-to-end deployments of our models inside life sciences organizations and research institutions. You will work with customers who are deep experts in their scientific or operational domains, translating real-world data, infrastructure, and constraints into production systems. You will measure success through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and eval-driven feedback loops, including evaluation benchmarks and acceptance criteria, that inform product and model roadmaps. You’ll work closely with our Product, Research, Partnerships, GRC, Security, and GTM to deliver in regulated contexts, including inspection readiness with audit trails and traceable evidence. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. In this role, you will: - Design and ship production systems around models, owning integrations, data provenance, reliability, and on-call readiness across research, clinical, and operational workflows. - Lead discovery and scoping from pre-sales through post-sales, translating ambiguous workflow needs into hypothesis-driven problem framing, system requirements, and an execution plan with measurable endpoints. - Define and enforce launch criteria for regulated contexts, including validation evidence, audit readiness, outcome metrics, and drive delivery until we demonstrate sustained production impact. - Build in sensitive scientific data environments where auditability, validation, and access controls shape architecture, operating procedures, and failure handling. - Run evaluation loops that measure model and system quality against workflow-specific scientific benchmarks and use results to drive model and product changes. - Distill deployment learnings into hardened primitives, reference architectures, validation templates, and benchmark harnesses that scale across regulated life sciences environments. You might thrive in this role if you: - Bring 5+ years of software/ML engineering or technical deployment experience with customer-facing ownership in biotech, pharma, clinical research, or scientific software; PhD, MS, or equivalent applied experience in a life sciences relevant field encouraged. - Have owned customer GenAI deployments end-to-end from scoping through production adoption, and improved them through evaluation design, error analysis, and iterative evidence generation that tightens acceptance criteria over time. - Have delivered AI systems in trial design, regulatory writing, or scientific operations where validation strategy, auditability, compliance constraints, and reviewer expectations shaped system design and rollout. - Communicate clearly across scientific, clinical, model research, technical, and executive audiences, translating technical tradeoffs into decision quality, risk posture, and measurable outcomes with credibility. - Apply systems thinking with high execution standards, consistently turning failures, escalations, and audit findings into improved operating standards, validation artifacts, and repeatable deployment playbooks. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
